changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: UPDATE agent_presets SET skill_names = skill_names || ARRAY['skill-loader', 'tool-loader'], updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name IN ('health-diary', 'platform-admin') AND NOT (skill_names @> ARRAY['tool-loader']);

changeSet.author: agimate
changeSet.sql: UPDATE skills SET md_content = replace(md_content, ' Инструменты `platform.*` (их схемы у тебя уже есть).', ' Инструменты — `platform.*`.'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND name = 'platform' AND md_content LIKE '%их схемы у тебя уже есть%'; UPDATE skills SET md_content = replace(md_content, ' The tools are `platform.*` (you already have their schemas).', ' The tools are `platform.*`.'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND name = 'platform' AND md_content LIKE '%you already have their schemas%';
